section_summary.extract_value: This section details the procedures for a study, including Institutional Review Board approval and the translation of the BSRS into Brazilian Portuguese using a back-translation technique. Participants were recruited from university campuses and completed paper-and-pencil questionnaires in a laboratory setting. Weight, height, and bra size measurements were taken, and a subsample of 100 participants completed the BSRS a second time after 15 days.
